Quality American Made Targets & Accessories

From humble beginnings in a basement to a full scale industrial building and warehouse, Thompson Target continues to grow as a major target producer distributing high quality targets and accessories to sporting goods stores, gun shops and shooting ranges nationwide. 

Still family owned and operated, we strive to continue providing uncompromised American made quality at competitive prices while promoting shooting sports and championing the protection of Constitutional Rights.

About us

Thompson Target strives to create the most innovative target shooting products in the industry.  Each design is meticulously crafted and printed on high quality paper using ultra bright inks at high density for a superior down range image.  

Plus, our attractive cascading displays efficiently merchandise our targets to maximize sales with a minimum footprint.  Choose Thompson Target when you're shooting for the best!
